headline: CFRESH (C) jumps 30.67% on strong volume and a 28.10% intraday surge, leading today's market activity.
market_take: Food stocks dominated the session with CFRESH up over 30% and APURE posting a 14.7σ volume spike. Property showed mixed signals as PF fell 20% while EVER rose 16.67% and several disposals were disclosed. Consumer and construction names such as PLE and TPOLY experienced sharp intraday drops and price gaps, adding pressure to the CONS sector. Capital‑raising activity was notable in PF&REIT, with multiple filings from MII PFREIT.

sector_notes.note: CFRESH surged 30.67% with a 4.3σ volume spike and a 28.10% intraday move; APURE recorded a 14.7σ volume spike and NRF rose 9.09% intraday. ZEN opened with a -100% price gap, indicating a possible delisting.
PF dropped 20% while EVER gained 16.67%; AMATA disclosed a disposal of subsidiary assets and WIN reported a capital‑change transaction that could affect its balance sheet.
PLE fell 14.29% intraday and filed a clarification on delayed wage payments; TPOLY opened with a -10% price gap and CIVIL rose 8.33% intraday.
GEL rose 33.33% and STECH advanced 10.20% on strong volume, highlighting renewed interest in construction materials.
SSPF declined 11.73% despite a 15.73× volume surge; MII PFREIT filed multiple capital‑change notifications regarding new trust unit offerings.
